user.title: Connect your Arbor parent portal
user.description: Use your school-specific Arbor URL and parent login. The integration only reads parent-visible data. Passwords are stored in Home Assistant's configuration; protect your backups.

error.invalid_auth: Arbor did not accept the login. Check your details and complete any first-login verification in the portal.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to read Arbor. Check the portal is available; its format may have changed.
error.invalid_url: Enter the school-specific HTTPS origin ending in .uk.arbor.sc, without a page path.

abort.already_configured: This school and account are already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Use the same school and email as the existing integration.

init.title: Arbor data options
init.description: Detailed personal records are available only through the admin-only get_student_data action. Enabling them includes profile, contact, medical, dietary and consent details; automation traces may retain action responses.
